snippet.title: Exer Gale - Official PS VR2 Announcement Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Exer Gale is a virtual reality arcade game for those who wish to fly and get away. The game gives you the freedom to glide, dive and climb in charming tropical environments using your body. Check out the trailer. Exer Gale is coming soon to PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2).
